question: In a closed circuit, if 100 coulomb charges flow for a duration of 50 sec, then the current drawn in the circuit is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Current (I) is defined as the amount of charge (Q) flowing per unit time (t).
 
• The formula to calculate current is I = Q/t.
 
• In this problem, Q = 100 coulombs and t = 50 seconds.
 
• Using the formula, I = 100 coulombs / 50 seconds.
